index_rule: Sort siblings by eleventyNavigation.order ascending; fractional values compare numerically. A missing order sorts AFTER every explicit order value (measured: behaves as +infinity, contradicting the docs' 'defaults to 0'). Order ties preserve the underlying collection order (content date ascending, then input path). Nav link text falls back to the eleventyNavigation key, not the page title.
section_rule: eleventyNavigation.parent names the key of the section to join; pages without parent are top-level.
sitemap_rule: no sitemap.xml in the starter build output (feed only)
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: Duplicate eleventyNavigation.key behavior; orphan parent values pointing at nonexistent keys; nesting deeper than one tier (starter template renders one tier only); interaction with draft frontmatter.
will_appear_if: eleventyNavigation.key is set in frontmatter AND the page is in a collection the eleventyNavigation filter is applied to AND eleventyExcludeFromCollections is not true

index_rule: Explicit sidebar config: position = index in the sidebar array in astro.config.mjs; frontmatter sidebar.order is ignored entirely. Autogenerate directory: sort by sidebar.order ascending, missing order sorts last, ties broken by slug/id (not title).
section_rule: Explicit groups defined by label/items arrays render in array order; an autogenerate directory forms one group.
sitemap_rule: no sitemap.xml in the default starter build output
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: Ordering between multiple autogenerate groups (starter has one); behavior when the sidebar key is omitted entirely; no working hide flag exists under explicit config in 0.42.3 (frontmatter sidebar.hidden and entry-level hidden:true both left the link in place). Official docs were unreachable in this run, so doc-vs-behavior agreement is unknown.
will_appear_if: Explicit sidebar config: the page's slug is listed in the sidebar array in astro.config.mjs. Autogenerate: the page is inside the autogenerate directory and does not set sidebar.hidden: true.

index_rule: Sort by sidebar_position ascending, numerically (fractional values allowed). Docs without sidebar_position sort after all positioned docs. Ties broken by filename (source basename), not title.
section_rule: A subdirectory forms a category (label from _category_.json); sidebar_position orders within the category.
sitemap_rule: build/sitemap.xml is emitted by the classic preset; its ordering rule was not probed
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: Ordering among multiple unpositioned docs (title vs filename) was not probed. Official docs were unreachable in this run, so doc-vs-behavior agreement is unknown.
will_appear_if: The doc is under the docs directory picked up by the autogenerated sidebar AND does not set draft: true.

index_rule: Position = exact index of the entry in the themeConfig.sidebar group's items array. No sorting is applied and there is no order key, so there is no tie concept.
section_rule: Groups are sidebar array entries with items arrays; group membership and within-group position come from items-array nesting; groups render in array order.
sitemap_rule: no sitemap file in the starter build output
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: Multi-sidebar path-prefix matching was not probed. Docs quotes are verbatim from the official published package's own documentation comments (vitepress.dev was unreachable), clearly labeled as such.
will_appear_if: The page has an entry in themeConfig.sidebar. A page file alone never appears in the nav.

index_rule: Sort by weight ascending, numerically. Entries without weight sort after all weighted entries. Weight ties sort alphabetically by entry name/title.
section_rule: menu parent: <identifier> nests the entry inside that menu item as a submenu list.
sitemap_rule: sitemap.xml is emitted by default; its ordering rule was not probed
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: Official docs were unreachable in this run, so doc-vs-behavior agreement is unknown. Tie-break beyond the single measured alphabetical case (e.g. identifier vs title precedence) was not probed.
will_appear_if: The page sets menu: main in frontmatter (or is added to menus in site config) AND is not draft: true.

index_rule: Sort by nav_order ascending, numerically (floats allowed). Pages without nav_order default to their title and sort alphabetically after all numerically-ordered pages. Equal nav_order is unstable and may change between builds (per the docs) — unpredictable in principle.
section_rule: parent: <title> on a child page nests it under that page; nav_order is relative among siblings sharing the same parent.
sitemap_rule: no sitemap.xml found in the starter _site output
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: The unstable tie order cannot be predicted in principle (the docs state it may change with each build).
will_appear_if: The page has a title (just-the-docs nav) AND does not set nav_exclude: true AND is not published: false.

index_rule: Position = exact index in the nav: list in mkdocs.yml. No sorting is applied; duplicate titles keep list order.
section_rule: Nested lists under a nav: key form sections; a child's position is its position in the section's list.
sitemap_rule: sitemap.xml and sitemap.xml.gz are emitted; their ordering rule was not probed
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: Implicit (nav-absent) ordering was not probed; awesome-pages .pages behavior was not probed. Official docs were unreachable in this run, so doc-vs-behavior agreement is unknown.
will_appear_if: The page is listed in nav: in mkdocs.yml. An unlisted .md file is still built as a page but excluded from the nav.

index_rule: Default: ascending by stem (filename without extension). An explicit .order(field, direction) on the navigation query overrides the default ordering.
section_rule: A subdirectory forms a section (title from _dir.yml); a page lands in its directory's section.
sitemap_rule: no sitemap found in this run
what_still_cannot_be_predicted: The official starter template renders no navigation element at all, so every placement claim is against a probe harness serializing queryCollectionNavigation into a generated page — real-theme rendering was not verified. Official docs were unreachable in this run.
will_appear_if: The page is under content/ AND does not set navigation: false.
